race.description: Affinity Electrical Technologies Single Gaze Hcp
race.comment: PELEUS (9) is the one to beat after a Randwick BM64 fourth, beaten just under two lengths by Graffiti Tycoon, and that followed a narrow Kembla Grange BM64 win as favourite. He is third-up, has recent form that profiles strongly and gets weight relief. No excuses today. HURRY MISS (5) comes back from Saturday company after finishing only two and a half lengths from Chix in a FM BM78 at Randwick, with a Moruya win the start before and proven Canberra form adding substance. Main danger. MY LAST HOORAY (4) was sound enough when fifth last time at this track and is better suited with weight relief, though the plain Kosciuszko run two back keeps him more in the place mix. Improver from the low gate. VELLA FOX (7) knuckled down strongly when finished 1.3 lengths from the winner at Gundagai. Can contest for a place.
